sections.introduction: Shwas Kuthar Ras is an Ayurvedic medicine in tablet or powder form. It is used in the treatment of asthma, dyspnea, chronic bronchitis etc.
sections.ingredients:
10 g fine powder of each of:- 

 Shuddha Parada – Purified Mercury 
 Shuddha Gandhaka – Purified Sulphur 
 Shuddha Vatsanabha – Purified Aconitum ferox 
 Tankana Bhasma – Borax 
 Manashila – Purified and processed Realgar (Arsenic di sulphide) 
 Shunti – Zingiber officinalis 
 Pippali – Piper longum 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum – 90 g 

 How to Make? 
 First make kajjali of mercury and sulphur, then add fine powder of rest of ingredients into it. Mix well together and triturate with water and finally make tablets.
sections.dosage:
125 – 250 mg once or twice a day, before or after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is traditionally administered along with honey, hot water.

sections.side_effects:
It contains heavy metal as ingredients, so its Self-medication may be dangerous. 
 Over-dosage may cause severe poisonous effect. 
 NOTE- It is best to be avoided in pregnancy, lactation and in children. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Shwas Kuthar Ras 
 Reference: Ayurveda Sara Sangraha, edition 17th, page no- 377-378. 
 Introduction 
 Shwas Kuthar Ras is an Ayurvedic medicine in tablet or powder form. It is used in the treatment of asthma, dyspnea, chronic bronchitis etc. 
 Ingredients 
 10 g fine powder of each of:- 
 
 Shuddha Parada – Purified Mercury 
 Shuddha Gandhaka – Purified Sulphur 
 Shuddha Vatsanabha – Purified Aconitum ferox 
 Tankana Bhasma – Borax 
 Manashila – Purified and processed Realgar (Arsenic di sulphide) 
 Shunti – Zingiber officinalis 
 Pippali – Piper longum 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum – 90 g 
 
 How to Make? 
 First make kajjali of mercury and sulphur, then add fine powder of rest of ingredients into it. Mix well together and triturate with water and finally make tablets. 
 Dosage 
 125 – 250 mg once or twice a day, before or after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is traditionally administered along with honey, hot water. 
 Indications 
 
 Cough 
 Cold 
 Asthma 
 Bronchitis 
 Anorexia 
 Indigestion 
 
 Side Effects 
 It contains heavy metal as ingredients, so its Self-medication may be dangerous. 
 Over-dosage may cause severe poisonous effect. 
 NOTE- It is best to be avoided in pregnancy, lactation and in children. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
